ollama.title: Ollama Settings
ollama.desc: Auto-detects local Ollama service and registers with DSH: when online it registers Ollama as an OpenAI-compatible Provider (writes to llm-pi-ai config), available on the WebUI Models page for selection. Model add/remove auto-syncs at probe interval. Saving below takes effect immediately (no restart needed) and reconnects with new config.

ollama.hint_endpoint: Ollama native API root, no /v1. Default http://localhost:11434. Customize for remote/other ports.
ollama.hint_display_name: The name shown on model selector page.
ollama.hint_ctx_window: Written to Models page model capacity + auto-created variant's num_ctx.
ollama.hint_max_output: Single output cap. Must be much smaller than context window (e.g. 32768/8192), or input space becomes zero.
ollama.hint_probe_interval: How often to probe Ollama. Faster = syncs model changes sooner but uses more resources.
ollama.hint_auth: pi-ai openai-completions requires apiKey or authorization header to pass. Ollama ignores this. Leave blank to send none.

ollama.msg_reconnected: Reconnected Ollama, models synced with current config

usage_stats.title: Usage Stats
usage_stats.desc: Scans all local session logs, aggregates token usage per model (input / output / cache read / cache write / reasoning). Cost estimated at DeepSeek official rates: input (cache miss) + input (cache hit) + output, each ÷1e6 × unit price. Reasoning tokens already counted in output, not double-billed. Price table editable below and saved to browser only (defaults to official peak rates, adjust to match actual). Running sessions may still be writing; stats reflect data at refresh time.
usage_stats.hint_no_deepseek: Not a DeepSeek account or no API Key configured. Balance query only works for DeepSeek, other features unaffected.
usage_stats.hint_no_balance_detail: DeepSeek did not return balance details
usage_stats.hint_logs_large: Scanning may take seconds when logs and sessions are large
usage_stats.price_hint: Unit = yuan per million tokens. Cost = input(miss)×price + input(hit)×price + output×price. Reasoning tokens already in output, no double charge. Default uses DeepSeek official peak rates (9-12/14-18 Beijing, peak = 2× off-peak). Adjust for actual prices/times.
usage_stats.turn_title_hint: Actual token consumption and estimated cost for this turn. Token categorized by DeepSeek billing rules: input split into cache miss/hit, reasoning already counted in output (no double-bill). Cost estimated from price table (Settings → Usage Stats). Balance is DeepSeek account real-time.
